meshes.label: DF200 wrist arch · frame
meshes.note: Feet on the Z 19.50 seat and rails at |Y| 14.8..27.1, outboard of the servo. TRUE 4 mm leg plates at |Y| 22.6..26.6, coplanar with the cheeks they feed: rev 1 lofted them between planes 5.1 mm apart while the profile climbed 51 mm, so the web measured 0.54-0.84 mm perpendicular. A 45° humped crossbar over the servo's connectors, the zip-tie lug and the 30..60° index fan. Prints UPRIGHT on its own two seat rails: 398.5 mm² of bed contact against rev 1's 0.0, and 12.5 % overhang. Support the two cheek undersides, the fan's lower edge and the crown hump.

meshes.label: DF200 wrist arch · camera head
meshes.note: The clamp block alone: 36.4 × 36.4 pocket, 3 mm lip, OPEN REAR, two ears. The tilt index seats are BLIND, 3.0 mm deep, and cut in BOTH side walls, which is what makes this ONE STL for the corner mast and the wrist arch. Prints lens face down on 975.8 mm² of bed contact, 5.5 % overhang. Support the two hinge-lug ends - a 23.7 mm bridge.

meshes.label: DF200 wrist arch · camera retainer
meshes.note: The 58 × 26 retainer plate with its 24 × 14 cable window, at its seated pose on the head's ears. NOT a plate of this set: print the shared "Camera retainer plate" upgrade instead. It is the same solid to 0.005 mm, measured on the exported meshes, and one of them serves every camera head this project builds. 2x M3 × 12 self-tapping into Ø2.60 × 9.50 pilots, 8.0 mm of bite.

meshes.label: DF200 wrist arch · DF200 module (stand-in)
meshes.note: The JR DF200 module itself, as a volumetric stand-in: 36 × 36 × 11 body, Ø20 × 9 lens barrel, Ø13 × 3 hood, 9 × 5 × 4 rear connector, sensor 4 mm behind the front face. Seated in the pocket at the shipped detent, front face on the 3 mm lip, barrel through the 30 × 30 aperture. The connector is on the image-UP axis, so it passes the retainer's 24 × 14 window. Measured on the exported meshes: module n head 0.001 mm³, connector n retainer 0.000 mm³. The retainer boss presses the back face by 0.40 mm (206 mm³ - the clamp preload; a 0.5 mm pocket shim goes behind a thinner module). NOT a printable part: it is what you buy.

wrist.source: user-confirmed JR DF200 "100° without distortion", 640 × 480 MJPG 4:3, rectilinear -> 87.3° H / 71.1° V (2026-09-15)

notes: The DF200 on the wrist, ahead of the servo instead of behind it: the motor and its LED leave the frame by GEOMETRY, not by tilt. Two plates, 42.0 g; 49.4 g with the shared retainer, against a 60 g budget. Tilt is a hinge detent, 30..60° in 5° steps. The framing model measures from the lens ENTRANCE PUPIL, 8 mm in front of the sensor point, not from the sensor. Shipped at 35°, where the servo LED clears the frame by 6.66°; at 40° it is 0.61° inside it. Only 30° and 35° pass every gate.
